title: Python Web & Backend Engineering
tagline: Build production web backends and full-stack apps in Python: HTTP and ASGI foundations, REST APIs with FastAPI, databases and ORMs (SQLAlchemy, Django), authentication and security, async and real-ti…
summary: Build production web backends and full-stack apps in Python: HTTP and ASGI foundations, REST APIs with FastAPI, databases and ORMs (SQLAlchemy, Django), authentication and security, async and real-time features, and shipping with Django, DRF, testing, and Docker. Covers the FastAPI/Django/Flask ecosystem end to end for Python backend and full-stack roles.

capstone.title: Deployed full-stack Python web application
capstone.project: Ship a deployed, authenticated web app or API backed by a real database, with migrations, tests for a core flow, a background job or real-time feature, and a documented architecture.

phases.title: Web & HTTP Foundations
phases.goal: Understand HTTP, WSGI/ASGI, and serve requests with Flask and FastAPI.

projects.title: HTTP Fundamentals & a No-Framework Server
projects.description: Build a tiny HTTP server with no web framework to learn methods, status codes, headers, and the request/response cycle — plus WSGI vs ASGI.

projects.title: Your First Flask App
projects.description: Build a small Flask web app with routes, request handling, and JSON responses — your first real (WSGI) web framework after the no-framework server.

projects.title: Your First FastAPI App
projects.description: Build a FastAPI app with type-hinted path operations, automatic validation, and auto-generated interactive docs — the modern async Python API framework.

projects.title: Routing, Parameters & Response Models
projects.description: Master FastAPI's parameter system — path, query, and body params with validation constraints — and response_model for shaping and filtering output.

projects.title: Server-Side Rendering with Jinja2
projects.description: Render HTML pages from templates with Jinja2: template inheritance, passing data, loops/conditionals, and why autoescaping protects against XSS.

projects.title: Dynamic UIs with HTMX
projects.description: Add interactivity to server-rendered pages using HTMX — swap HTML fragments returned by your backend on user actions, no JavaScript framework required.

projects.title: Calling External APIs (httpx)
projects.description: Make your backend an HTTP client: call third-party APIs with httpx (sync and async), handle timeouts, retries, and errors, and keep API keys server-side.

phases.title: REST APIs & Validation
phases.goal: Design clean REST APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic — params, validation, errors, docs, pagination, uploads.

projects.title: REST API Design
projects.description: Design and build a clean CRUD REST API for a resource: correct HTTP verbs and status codes, consistent resource URLs, and predictable behavior.

projects.title: Deep Validation with Pydantic
projects.description: Go beyond basic types: field constraints, custom validators, nested models, computed fields, and clear validation errors — making your API reject bad data at the edge.

projects.title: Error Handling & Contracts
projects.description: Give your API one consistent error shape with custom exceptions and FastAPI exception handlers, so clients always get predictable, useful errors without leaking internals.

projects.title: Dependency Injection
projects.description: Use FastAPI's Depends to share logic across endpoints — DB sessions, current-user lookup, pagination params, config — keeping handlers clean and testable.

projects.title: Pagination, Filtering & Sorting
projects.description: Add scalable list endpoints: offset and cursor pagination, safe filtering and sorting, and metadata so clients can page through large datasets without dumping the whole table.

projects.title: File Uploads
projects.description: Accept file uploads safely in FastAPI: enforce type and size limits, store files, serve them back, and reject dangerous or oversized files.

projects.title: API Versioning
projects.description: Evolve an API without breaking existing clients: URL vs header versioning, organizing versioned routers, and a deprecation strategy.

projects.title: OpenAPI & Docs Customization
projects.description: Polish your API's auto-generated OpenAPI docs: tags, summaries, descriptions, examples, response documentation, and metadata — so the interactive docs are genuinely useful.

phases.title: Databases & ORMs
phases.goal: Model and query relational data with SQLAlchemy and Django ORM, with migrations and transactions.

projects.title: SQLAlchemy Core & Connections
projects.description: Connect to a database and run queries with SQLAlchemy Core: engine, connections, parameterized statements, and the connection lifecycle — the layer the ORM is built on.

projects.title: SQLAlchemy ORM
projects.description: Map Python classes to database tables with the SQLAlchemy ORM: declarative models, sessions, and full CRUD using objects instead of raw SQL.

projects.title: Relationships & Joins
projects.description: Model connections between tables — one-to-many and many-to-many — with foreign keys and SQLAlchemy relationships, and query across them with joins.

projects.title: The N+1 Problem & Eager Loading
projects.description: Diagnose and fix the N+1 query problem — the most common ORM performance bug — using eager loading (joinedload/selectinload) and query inspection.

projects.title: Schema Migrations with Alembic
projects.description: Manage database schema changes with Alembic: generate migrations from model changes, apply and roll them back, and keep environments in sync.

projects.title: Transactions & Data Integrity
projects.description: Make multi-step database operations all-or-nothing with transactions (commit/rollback), and use constraints and isolation to keep data consistent under concurrency.

projects.title: The Django ORM
projects.description: Use Django's batteries-included ORM: models, the QuerySet API, migrations, relationships, and the admin — contrasting it with SQLAlchemy.

projects.title: The Repository Pattern
projects.description: Decouple business logic from data access with a repository layer, so your code depends on an interface (not the ORM) and is easy to test and swap.

phases.title: Authentication & Security
phases.goal: Secure an API: password hashing, JWT/OAuth, sessions, RBAC, CSRF/CORS, rate limiting.

projects.title: Password Hashing
projects.description: Store passwords safely: hash with a slow, salted algorithm (bcrypt/argon2), verify on login, and learn why you must never store or encrypt plaintext passwords.

projects.title: JWT Authentication
projects.description: Implement token-based auth in FastAPI: issue a signed JWT on login, protect routes by verifying it, and understand what a JWT is, what it isn't, and where to store it.

projects.title: OAuth2 & Social Login
projects.description: Let users log in with a third-party provider (Google/GitHub) via the OAuth2 authorization-code flow, learning what OAuth delegates and why you never handle the user's provider password.

projects.title: Sessions & Cookies
projects.description: Implement classic server-side session auth with secure cookies: create a session on login, store it server-side, and set cookies with the right security flags.

projects.title: Authorization & RBAC
projects.description: Control what authenticated users can do with role-based access control: assign roles, restrict endpoints by role, deny by default, and keep checks where they can't be bypassed.

projects.title: CSRF, CORS & Web Security
projects.description: Defend against cross-site attacks: configure CORS correctly, protect against CSRF, and apply key web-security headers and input-handling habits.

projects.title: Rate Limiting
projects.description: Protect endpoints from abuse with per-client rate limiting: implement a limiter, return 429 with the right headers, and understand fixed-window vs token-bucket and why in-memory limits fail at scale.

phases.title: Async & Real-Time
phases.goal: Build async endpoints, WebSockets, SSE, background jobs (Celery), and caching.

projects.title: Async Endpoints & Async Databases
projects.description: Write truly async FastAPI endpoints with an async database driver, learning when async helps, the danger of blocking calls in async code, and async sessions.

projects.title: WebSockets
projects.description: Build real-time, bidirectional communication with WebSockets in FastAPI: a chat/broadcast server that pushes messages to connected clients instantly.

projects.title: Server-Sent Events (SSE)
projects.description: Stream one-way real-time updates from server to client with Server-Sent Events — simpler than WebSockets for live feeds, notifications, and progress updates.

projects.title: Background Tasks
projects.description: Do slow work after responding using FastAPI BackgroundTasks — send emails, write logs, process data without making the client wait — and learn its limits.

projects.title: Distributed Jobs with Celery & Redis
projects.description: Run durable, scalable background jobs with Celery and a Redis broker: enqueue tasks, process them in separate workers, track status, and handle retries and failures.

projects.title: Caching with Redis
projects.description: Speed up expensive reads by caching results in Redis: cache-aside pattern, TTLs, and correct invalidation on writes — the classic performance win with the classic hard problem.

projects.title: Streaming Responses
projects.description: Stream large or generated responses instead of building them fully in memory: StreamingResponse for big files/exports and chunked generation, keeping memory flat.

phases.title: Frameworks, Testing & Deployment
phases.goal: Ship with Django/DRF, GraphQL, automated tests, and a deployed, containerized service.

projects.title: A Full Django App
projects.description: Build a complete Django app end to end: models, migrations, views, URL routing, templates, and forms — using Django's integrated, convention-driven stack.

projects.title: Django REST Framework
projects.description: Build a REST API the Django way with DRF: serializers, viewsets, routers, and the browsable API — getting full CRUD endpoints with minimal code.

projects.title: GraphQL with Strawberry
projects.description: Build a GraphQL API with Strawberry: define a schema with types, queries, and mutations, and learn how GraphQL differs from REST — and its tradeoffs like the N+1 problem.

projects.title: Testing Web APIs
projects.description: Write automated tests for a FastAPI app with TestClient and pytest: test endpoints end-to-end, cover success and failure paths, and override dependencies to isolate the unit under test.

projects.title: Database Testing
projects.description: Test code that uses a database against a real test database with fixtures and per-test isolation (transaction rollback), so tests are realistic yet fast and independent.

projects.title: Containerize & Serve in Production
projects.description: Package a FastAPI app in Docker and run it with a production ASGI server (uvicorn workers / gunicorn), with multiple workers, health checks, and reverse-proxy awareness.

projects.title: Logging, Config & Observability
projects.description: Make a web app operable: structured request logging, environment-based settings (Pydantic Settings), and basic observability so you can debug production from logs.

projects.title: Deploying to Production
projects.description: Deploy your containerized app to a reachable URL with a hosted database, production config, and a deploy checklist — the last mile that makes your work real.
